title: Praxis with a split coefficient ring of degree 4479
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 7890 MiB (7.7046 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 26813 million field multiplications (19725 and 7088), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, H3, dec_sum_g1, P1, n, C5) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
